{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999,999.99)
qa_pattern = '999,999.99'
completed_clean = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != qa_pattern]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_df))
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99'):", len(completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] == qa_pattern]))
print("Number of completed orders after removing QA:", len(completed_clean))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning and removing QA):"," , mean_revenue)"}}
